name: Managed money z-score, WTI-PHYSICAL
license: Calculated from US government series stored in this archive
method: Managed-money net divided by open interest on CFTC 067651. Z-score uses the train mean and the train population standard deviation of that ratio. Train mean 0.1146. Train standard deviation 0.0386. The percentile is the share of train ratios at or below the current print. Spreads are not inside the net.
